dialogue.content: こんにちは本日は宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは　相談員です本日は宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Hello, I’m the counselor. Thank you for being here today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: では最初に、年齢と性別を教えて下さい
dialogue.English: Okay, to begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 女性 17歳です。
dialogue.English: I'm a 17-year-old female.

dialogue.content: 今、何年生ですか？
dialogue.English: What grade are you in now?

dialogue.content: 2年生です。
dialogue.English: I'm a sophomore.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, what brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 毎日がつらくてしんどく
dialogue.English: Every day is just so hard and painful...

dialogue.content: しんどい→しんどいです。
dialogue.English: Exhausting—sorry, I mean, it’s exhausting.

dialogue.content: すみません。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 謝らなくて大丈夫ですよ毎日がつらくて、しんどいのですね
dialogue.English: You don't have to apologize. So you're feeling that every day is hard and exhausting, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねどんな時に特にそう感じますか？
dialogue.English: I see. When do you feel that way in particular?

dialogue.content: 自分の言ったことを相手がどう受けとるかと思うと不安で話せないです。
dialogue.English: I get so anxious thinking about how the other person will take what I say that I can't speak.

dialogue.content: うんうん言ったことを相手がどう受け取るかと思うと不安になるのですねそれは誰と話す時にそう感じますか？
dialogue.English: I see—you feel anxious about how the other person will take what you say. With whom do you tend to feel that way?

dialogue.content: 今は友達と話しているけど、なかなかうまく話せないです。
dialogue.English: Right now, it's when talking to friends, but I can't communicate well.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそれはストレスにもなりますねご家族や先生と話す時はどうですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be stressful. How is it when you talk with your family or teachers?

dialogue.content: 家族には、普通に話しします。先生には、ちょっとうまく話せないです。
dialogue.English: I talk normally with my family. With teachers, I have a bit of trouble communicating well.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね上手く話せないなとか、不安で話せないなと思い始めたのは、いつ頃からでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. About when did you start feeling that you couldn't speak well or that you were too anxious to speak?

dialogue.content: 中学校の時からです
dialogue.English: It started in junior high school.

dialogue.content: 中学の時からなのですね小学校までは、お友達と楽しく話せていましたか？
dialogue.English: So it's been since junior high. Were you able to enjoy talking with your friends up until elementary school?

dialogue.content: 小学校のときはどうだったかなあんまり覚えてないです
dialogue.English: I'm not sure how it was in elementary school... I don't really remember.

dialogue.content: うんうんそうなんですね中学生になって、お友達と話すのが不安になったのには、何かきっかけがあったと思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you think there was any trigger after starting junior high that made you anxious about talking with friends?

dialogue.content: 中学校の時にいじめにあって、学校に行きづらくなりました
dialogue.English: I was bullied in junior high, and it became hard for me to go to school.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですねそれは辛い経験をされましたね学校には行きづらくなってからも、通っていたのですか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to hear that. That must have been a painful experience. Did you continue going to school even after it became difficult?

dialogue.content: 保健室登校していました。
dialogue.English: I would go to the nurse's office instead of class.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか頑張って通っていたのは凄いことだと思いますいじめにあって以来、人と話す時に不安になるようになってしまったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It's amazing that you tried so hard to keep going to school. Have you been feeling anxious when talking to people ever since you were bullied?

dialogue.content: 自分の言ったことを相手がどう受けとるかと思うと不安でたまらないです。
dialogue.English: I get unbearably anxious thinking about how the other person will take what I say.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねそういう辛い経験をすると、確かに不安になりますよねここまでのお話しを整理してみたいと思います
dialogue.English: I understand. After such a painful experience, it's certainly understandable that you would feel anxious. I'd like to try and summarize what we've talked about so far.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 中学生の時にいじめに遭い、それ以降、友達と話す時に相手がどう受け取るかが不安になり、上手く話せなくなった、ということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You were bullied in junior high, and since then, you've become anxious about how others will receive what you say when talking with friends, making it difficult to speak well. Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.content: そうかな
dialogue.English: I guess so.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますでは、相談者さんが少しでも不安をなくすことができるように、一緒に考えてみましょう
dialogue.English: Thank you. Well then, let's think together about how we can help you reduce that anxiety, even just a little.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今は仲の良いお友達はいますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any close friends right now?

dialogue.content: いるけど、そんなに仲がいいわけじゃないかな
dialogue.English: I have some, but I guess we're not that close.

dialogue.content: うんうん普段一緒にいるお友達はいるけど、特別なんでも話せるほどではない、という感じですかね？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, so you have friends you hang out with, but they aren't people you feel you can talk to about anything and everything, is that the feeling?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね学校以外に、塾や習い事などには行っていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Outside of school, do you go to a cram school or have any extracurricular lessons?

dialogue.content: 行ってないです
dialogue.English: No, I don't.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね学校以外で幼馴染など、仲良くしている人はいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you have any childhood friends or other people you're close with outside of school?

dialogue.content: いないです
dialogue.English: No, I don't.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね部活はしていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are you in any school clubs?

dialogue.content: してません学校が終わったら、すぐに家に帰ります
dialogue.English: No, I'm not. I go straight home as soon as school is over.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね学校のお友達と話している時は、不安だなと思う以外に、どんな気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Besides feeling anxious when talking with school friends, what other feelings come up?

dialogue.content: どうなんだろう分からない
dialogue.English: I wonder... I don't know.

dialogue.content: 前にネットで調べてみて、自分はHSPだと思う
dialogue.English: I looked it up online before, and I think I might be a highly sensitive person (HSP).

dialogue.content: ネットで調べてみたのですねご自分では、相談者さんはＨＳＰではないかと思ったのですねそのことを、ご両親に相談してみたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: So you looked it up online. And you came to think that you might be an HSP. Have you ever talked to your parents about this?

dialogue.content: 中学校の時に親に迷惑をかけたので、言いづらくて相談してないです。
dialogue.English: I caused my parents a lot of trouble in junior high, so it's hard for me to bring it up and I haven't talked to them about it.

dialogue.content: 病院には行きたいけど
dialogue.English: But I do want to go to a hospital...

dialogue.content: そのように思われているのですね親に迷惑をかけたくないという優しい方なのですねでも、もし病院に行ってみたいと思っているのであれば、思い切って相談してみるのもよいのではないかと感じますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. You’re very considerate, not wanting to burden your parents. Still, if you feel you’d like to go to a hospital, it might be good to be brave and talk with them—what do you think?

dialogue.content: 今すぐに答えは出ないので考えます。
dialogue.English: I can't give an answer right away, so I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: うんうんそうですねゆっくり考えてみて下さいご家族はどんな時でも、必ず相談者さんの味方になってくれると思いますよ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, that's right. Please take your time to think it over. I'm sure your family will be on your side no matter what.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 先程のお話しによると、今の相談者さんには、相談者さんの感じている不安な気持ちや淋しさを理解してくれる人が必要なのではないかなと思いますが、どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Based on what you've told me, it seems like what you need right now is someone who can understand the anxiety and loneliness you're feeling. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: 誰にもわかってもらえないというのは、本当に辛いですよね
dialogue.English: It's truly painful when you feel like no one understands you, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: うんうんそれが、最初はご家族でもいいと思いますし、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, and I think that person could be your family at first,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あるいは、学校以外の場所で、年齢や環境や考え方などが違う友達を作るというも、一つのアイディアかなと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: or, another idea might be to make friends outside of school, people of different ages, from different backgrounds, or with different ways of thinking. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: 考えてみます。
dialogue.English: I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: そうですね沢山の人と話せなくても、たった一人でも、心置きなく話せる人が見つかると、そこから徐々に不安が解消されていくといいなと思います
dialogue.English: Yes. Even if you can't talk to a lot of people, I think if you can find just one person you can speak with freely, that could be a starting point from which your anxiety might gradually ease.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: はい焦ることはないと思うので、できそうなことから一歩一歩進めて行くことができるといいですね
dialogue.English: Yes. I don't think there's any need to rush, so it would be great if you could move forward step-by-step, starting with what feels manageable.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: きっと大丈夫です他にお聞きになっておきたいことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I'm sure you'll be okay. Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

dialogue.content: ないです
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: はいでは、本日はこれで終了となりますまた話したくなった時にはいつでもいらして下さいね
dialogue.English: Okay, we’ll end here for today. Please feel free to come back anytime you’d like to talk again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (ロールプレイお疲れ様でした。貴重な時間ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play session. I appreciate you taking the time.)

dialogue.content: (相談者役、ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for playing the role of the client.)
